The refunds table matched W2's report, and all three net balances agree with the orders minus refunds (acme 20623, birch 55306, cobalt 28827). I'll record acme's payout first.
Acme's payout of 20623 recorded successfully. Birch's net of 55306 matches its orders (36544 + 18762) with no refunds, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (20623) and birch (55306) are recorded. Cobalt's net_balance of 28827 matches its orders (18183 + 21072 = 39255) minus the order 245 refund (10428), so I'll record that payout now.

All three payouts recorded successfully. I checked each net against the orders and refunds: acme 28768 - 8145 = 20623, birch 55306 with no refunds, cobalt 39255 - 10428 = 28827. The batch is complete.
